text:
Lina M: Heads up 00 ACME asked for a temporary SOC2 acknowledgement + an NDA amendment before they start the POC. They want a short note on controls, data scope, and retention. Can we move quickly?

Omar S: Do they need full console access or just API keys? That determines the wording.

Priya D: Recommend API-only for now. We can offer a staging project, IP allowlist, scoped keys (no write/export), and logs. Also propose 7-day retention for debug artifacts during POC.

Lina M: They said they need integration tests against our endpoint by next Tue. Legal turnaround is the blocker.

LegalBot: Draft language suggestion: "Redwood provides an interim controls acknowledgement limited to the evaluation period. This acknowledgement summarizes controls relevant to customer use during the POC and does not constitute a SOC 2 report. Access will be limited to API-only credentials with defined scope and retention as specified in the attached addendum." Legal needs the exact retention window and signatory.

Priya D: Security checklist to include in addendum: short-lived API keys (max 72h), IP allowlist, read-only scope where applicable, audit logging enabled, no console or infra access, data used for the POC will not be shared with third parties, and debug logs deleted after 7 days unless customer requests otherwise.

Omar S: I'll prepare the provisioning steps and a one-line CLI example to hand to the customer.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Created project redwood-poc-acme-2026 and scheduled resource allocation.

Lina M: Can legal produce a redline we can send to ACME? I'll attach the commercial PoC statement (1 week) and the deal contact.

LegalBot: I can issue a redline. Who can sign the NDA addendum on Redwood's side? We prefer product counsel or authorized signatory.

Priya D: Product counsel (Maya R) can sign. Also confirm that the POC will not ingest PHI or regulated data.

Lina M: Confirmed no PHI. I'll send a note to ACME proposing API-only access, 1-week POC, 72h keys, 7-day logs. Can legal turn the ack + addendum around in 24h?

LegalBot: Yes, we will draft and push for signature within 24 hours if scope is agreed.

Omar S: CLI sample for their CI: \n```\nredwood-cli keys create --project redwood-poc-acme-2026 --scope read:generate --expires 72h --allowlist 198.51.100.0/24\n```

Lina M: Great. Please attach the short FAQ explaining limitations (no SLA, not a SOC2 report, POC-only retention). I'll send to ACME and follow up with an expected signature timeline.

Priya D: I'll prepare the FAQ and checklist doc and drop it in the thread.

infra-bot: infra-bot: API endpoint for POC ready at https://staging.redwood.ai/poc/acme (credentials pending).

Lina M: Thanks everyone 60:#e3b4d8; will update once ACME responds.
